traps: sum/fastsum.c is not a C unit and has no build file: the go command compiles it as part of package sum because the directory has a file that imports "C"
the C flags live in #cgo comment lines of sum/sum.go, not in a Makefile or CMake file; FASTSUM_UNROLL=4 is defined there and changes which loop fastsum.c compiles
-lm is linked only on linux (#cgo linux LDFLAGS)
with CGO_ENABLED=0 (the default when cross-compiling) sum.go is dropped and sum_nocgo.go defines Floats: the C files are then unused
C.fastsum and C.size_t are not Go declarations anywhere: a Go indexer without cgo preprocessing sees unresolved names
